PluginData.Author: dawidmachon
PluginData.Tooltip: Sort inventory containers by remaining free cargo space (most empty first)
PluginData.Description:
Adds a Sort checkbox to the ship/station inventory terminal that reorders containers by remaining free cargo space (most-empty first).
Features: - One-click Sort checkbox right in the inventory UI, next to Hide Empty - Most-empty cargo containers rise to the top so you can find a place to drop items fast - Hides itself on the character/suit filter (mirrors Hide Empty behavior) - State remembered across sessions, enabled by default - Optional setting to also sort the left (production) panel
